pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, stellate-edged dark regions with high-frequency marginal jaggedness. Patches exhibit significant variation in spatial area, transitioning from large, elongated shapes on the lower neck to smaller, more fragmented polygons on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous lattice of light-cream negative space forming a complex network of nodes. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and consistent across the mid-flank, becoming more constrained between smaller posterior patches.
